prompts.name: 共生花瓣
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE contemporary graphic-first CORPORATE LOGO EMBLEM for Chinese company 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. The user has rejected logos that simply write Chinese characters with lotus outlines because they look old-fashioned. Start from an ORIGINAL THREE-PETAL INTERLOCKING SYMBOL, a compact asymmetric open bloom with a distinctive silhouette and plenty of white space. Two outer petals share branching stem-like turns derived from 林; the inward turning left petal and one small seed-shaped cut recall 礼. These letterform gestures are transformed into the petal geometry, NOT printed readable Chinese text. Do not arrange 礻 plus two 木 in a horizontal row. Make one memorable modern graphic that can be redrawn from memory in a few strokes. Philosophy 善心 is the embracing heart-like central white opening, 善念 is the real shared connection between petals, 善行 is an open outward rising tip. No separate heart sticker. Clean soft geometric curves with medium-light thickness and blunt precise terminals, 3 main shapes maximum, balanced positive/negative space. Original design, not a generic wellness lotus, not a flower enclosing type. Flat opaque forest green #36593E on pure white. ONE emblem centered with generous margins; NO rendered text at all. No Chinese glyph typesetting, serif, calligraphy, complete written characters, lotus outline surrounding words, circular border, heavy badge, tiny veins, gratuitous leaf clipart, gradient, shadow, 3D, texture or mockup.

prompts.name: 折瓣向新
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE original graphic-first corporate identity emblem for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO, serving software, engineering and ecological services. It must look like a memorable MODERN SYMBOL rather than a written Chinese word. Direction: TWO INTERLOCKING FOLDED PETAL RIBBONS and one open central lotus petal. Use the paired vertical-and-fork rhythm of 林 as the starting geometry, and the dot/turn/open hook of 礼 as a second source, then radically simplify these into ONE light compact folded lotus emblem. Avoid a literal row of 礻木木, no complete Chinese character written out. Three large negative openings, clipped diagonal ends, softly curved petal backs, a calm slightly forward-moving silhouette. More air than solid ink. One visible shared structural join conveys 善念, the broad accepting middle opening conveys 善心, the final open outward tip conveys 善行. No added pictograms or cute hearts. Original proprietary icon with a clear silhouette that works in an app or website header, medium-to-light optical weight, few shapes. Solid flat #36593E green on pure white only. One centered standalone symbol, generous margin, no brand text or caption. Not font lettering, calligraphy, square seal, mountain peaks, book, crown, generic leaf, infinite knot, line-art flower frame, gradient, shadow, 3D or mockup. Make petal curves unmistakably floral but contemporary.

prompts.name: 留白生长
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. ONE original youthful yet professional corporate LOGO SYMBOL for 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. The client dislikes old-looking text logos. Direction: a compact airy TWO-PETAL CRADLE with a third rising lotus petal, sculpted from rounded geometric bands and cut-through white channels. Central figure-ground construction should recall a simplified 礼 turning gesture; the two branching petal supports borrow the twin-wood rhythm of 林, but neither name character is fully typeset or printed. This is typographic source material transformed into ONE distinctive symbol, not hidden tiny text. Make the silhouette genuinely different from an upright printed character: low embracing base and off-center rising opening, no frame around words, no literal forest drawing. 善心 = accepting central white space with a very subtle heart-seed contour; 善念 = two petal supports sharing a joint; 善行 = a clear open channel continuing outward. Use only 2-3 well-proportioned green forms with generous spaces, medium-light weight, comfortable rounded corners, a distinctive original outline; do not imitate known brands. All flat solid dark green #36593E on pure white, single centered emblem, lots of white margins. NO text or captions, no Chinese font glyphs, brush script, heavy block or badge, flower-outline enclosing characters, stock spa icon, cartoon heart, generic loop, detailed veins, gradients, shadows, 3D or mockups.
